checks.description: LaTeX compiles to PDF without fatal errors
Uses the bundled acmart class with the sigconf format
US Letter paper (8.5 x 11 in)
All fonts embedded in the PDF
No packages that change the ACM margins, fonts, spacing or headings
Abstract present
Keywords present
Review version names no authors
Every referenced figure file is present and embeddable
Every citation key has a bibliography entry
No undefined \ref labels
Paper has a reference list
No text sticking into the margin (overfull boxes larger than 5pt)
Every character prints (no glyphs missing from the font)
Abstract of one or two paragraphs
Every figure has a \Description for readers who cannot see it
CCS concepts in the final version
Title in title case, without forced line breaks
References give DOIs and full author names

params.doi_rule: ACM asks for the DOI of each reference that has one

checks.description: Each affiliation gives institution, city and country
British or American spelling, not both
No \newcommand in the final version

params.message: ACM's production system (TAPS) rejects papers that define their own commands. Replace these with the text they stand for before the final upload.

checks.description: Abbreviations are spelled out at first use
No plain underscores in the text
Images print at 150 dpi or more
Review version gives no hint of the authors (self-citations, links, emails, grants)
ACM conferences set their own page limits and review rules; check your conference's call for papers
For camera-ready, replace the placeholder rights block in main.tex with the text from your ACM rights form
If you used generative AI, say so in the acknowledgments (spelling and grammar tools are exempt)
No leftover notes to self (\todo, TODO, FIXME)

params.message: The paper still has notes to self. Remove them, or write the missing text, before you submit.

checks.description: Typed figure and table numbers match the paper, and every figure and table has a caption

manual_review_items: Author names, affiliations and emails were copied from your upload; confirm them in the camera-ready version.
Equation, table and figure placement may differ from your original layout.
